prompts.name: keepsake-story-v1
prompts.prompt: Create a warm children's English course keepsake illustration, wide 3:2, genuine transparent background. Story: a mother with short dark curly hair, broad friendly face, rust terracotta short jacket, pale yellow shirt, blue-grey trousers, and her two children. Girl has brown pigtails, mustard yellow dress, boy has dark tousled hair, teal striped shirt and blue shorts. Both children are seated together on a simple small wooden park bench on the right, each holding exactly ONE pink ice-cream cone (exactly TWO cones total). Mother at left stands turned toward them, smiling, empty hands open gently. Full bodies, complete heads hands and feet, leave transparent margins around entire group. Express affectionate everyday gratitude, no moral slogans. Rounded friendly 2D picture-book forms, thick clean cocoa outlines, flat soft cream, sage, mustard, terracotta and teal colors, light restrained shading, polished like modern preschool illustrations, no realistic painting, no text, letters, numbers, labels, stars, trophy, frame, watermark, floating decoration, ground rectangle or background scenery. Keep silhouettes clear at small size. Not the office characters. Keep mother recognizably an adult parent, not elderly. No extra people or cones.
